qa_pairs.answer: Cavo adattatore: senza cat 1 684 463 124 / con cat 1 684 463 128

qa_pairs.question: In which test cycle should you check the rpm signal transducer with an oscilloscope?
What should you do with the engine during the reference signal transducer test in cycle 15?
qa_pairs.answer: Disinnestare la marcia e avviare il motore (Disengage gear and start the engine)

qa_pairs.question: What voltage threshold is shown as US>2V in the second oscilloscope display?
What should you do to test the electronic control unit connection in test cycle 20?
qa_pairs.answer: Disinserire l'accensione e collegare la centralina elettronica (Turn off ignition and connect the electronic control unit)
